notes.title: Trouble with Bomb disarm?
notes.content:
(detailed guide)

A bomb is divided in 4 different modules.
A module which does not contain leds or switches is considered [b]Inactive[/b]

The [b]Active[/b] types of modules are mainly 3:
- the cables module
- the led module
- the switches module

1. The Cables module
This module is pretty intuitive: you need to cut one or more cables by following the instructions.

2. The Led module
This module contains a grid of leds. On the manual there will be written more than one possible combinations. Click on a led to change its color in order to match one of the combinations given.

3. The Switches module
By the order given on the manual you need to switch all the buttons to ON or OFF according to the lights on both the sides of the bomb (rotate the bomb to see)

Any other questions below.
Thank you and have fun! :)
